# l2-scripts

The code behind L2's checks and tools, with their tests: the DAK data dictionary reader (workbook to a `dak-data-dictionary/v1` annex) and its term diff, and the L2 DTH check under `dth/`. Scripts that L1 code, an always-on piece or a platform layer also reaches stay in `../../scripts/` even when their subject is L2, because this subgraph is opt-in.

Part of [SMART Base](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `l2-scripts`, holding `code`.
